description.short: ProjectIQ projects, portfolio, resources, purchasing and hours in Copilot.
description.full: An intent-driven Copilot agent on live ProjectIQ data: portfolio and project health, budget, timeline, project documents, resource load, purchasing status, supplier compliance, approval of hours and logging and submitting your timesheet, with your own Dataverse permissions.
